summary: The state is not sealed. Attributes, outputs and stored plans are stored as plain text, and anyone who can read s3://acme-state/estate can read every value.

file.text: The repository lists readers in .pravo/access/readers.txt, but the state is not sealed. It has not been sealed yet, or its meta.json was changed.

recovery.text: No recovery recipient. If every reader loses their key, the state cannot be read.

suggestions.title: Check why the state is not sealed
suggestions.why: The readers file lists readers, so the state was expected to be sealed, and it is not. It has not been sealed yet, or someone who can write to the store changed its meta.json.

steps.text: If you did not mean to seal this state, remove the readers file. To seal it: pravo protect init --encrypt

suggestions.title: Seal the state
suggestions.why: Sealing encrypts attributes, outputs and stored plans to the readers in the file. It needs the store at rest, so announce a short freeze.
suggestions.who: each reader, then one of them

steps.text: On the machine of each reader:
The readers file lists 3 readers. A reader who is not listed sends their line, and it is added to .pravo/access/readers.txt.
